content: loop is a boolean content attribute: loop='false' STILL loops - must removeAttribute('loop'). ended event never fires while loop attribute is present (spec: seek to earliest position and return before firing ended). loop attribute is observable via MutationObserver with attributeFilter:['loop'] - confirmed by whatwg/html#2691. Blocking strategy: MutationObserver on video elements, remove loop attr, then ended event fires -> we can pause (autoplay-loop block) or let it stop. Autoplay blocked videos: play() promise rejects with AbortError; setting muted+playsinline is required for autoplay in iOS/WKWebView; WKWebView needs allowsInlineMediaPlayback=true and mediaTypesRequiringUserActionForPlayback=[] native-side.
